definition: first eligible daily close crossing; opposite risk/objective boundary is a competing event

thresholds_net_return.selection_note: predeclared descriptive levels, not fitted to maximize outcomes

entry_exit.S3-A/S3-D: signal at close t; hypothetical adjusted next-session open entry; close at t+H; H=1 exits entry-session close
entry_exit.S3-B: signal at close t; next-session open entry; close at t+H; H=1 exits next-session close; outcome subtracts official TradeSim-history SET50 price-index close-to-close return from t through t+H
entry_exit.S3-C: gap observed after open; hypothetical entry at gap-session close (not an open fill); close H observed sessions later

costs.one_tick_each_side: adverse one SET tick at raw entry and exit, using scripts/run_design_a_backtest.py tick schedule; OHLC proxy only, not a fill model
costs.returns_are: daily-bar adjusted-price estimates; no BBO, queue, executable volume, or IOC fill probabilities

metadata.reuse_and_oos: Every source observation used here has been inspected in prior research; no independent OOS. Chronological slices and horizon reanalysis do not create new confirmation.
metadata.first_passage_competing_risk: opposite +/-1% boundary is treated as competing event for +/-1% and +/-2% targets; the other boundary is +1% for adverse thresholds; -1% for first-positive.
metadata.right_censoring: 15 observed sessions with neither target nor competing boundary hit
metadata.insufficient_followup: censored at last available eligible daily close and retained in cohort denominator
metadata.uncertainty: 2,000 two-way date/symbol pigeonhole bootstrap replications; 95% percentile intervals on cumulative target-first incidence by session; dependence and small-cluster limits apply
